component.name: Yeet
component.summary: Wayland-native interactive stream throwing system for OBS

description.p: Yeet is a modern, pure Wayland-native alternative to Twitch Integrated Throwing System (T.I.T.S.), designed according to the GNOME Human Interface Guidelines. Built with GTK4 and Libadwaita, Yeet empowers livestreamers and VTubers to set up interactive 2D collision targets, configure throwable items with custom sound effects, and render physics overlays in OBS Studio.

ul.li: Resolution-independent normalized collision targets (Box, Circle, VTuber Pill/Capsule, and custom Polygon convex hull)
Interactive drag-and-drop coordinate mapper canvas with stream backdrop alignment
Customizable throwable items supporting PNG, WebP, GIF, and SVG images
Matter.js 2D physics simulation running in an ultra-low-latency HTML5 browser source
Polyphonic Web Audio collision sound effects with volume and pitch randomization
Built-in audio limiter and debounce to prevent sound clipping during barrage throws
Embedded local HTTP REST API and WebSocket daemon for integration with Streamer.bot, MixItUp, and chat triggers
One-click OBS Browser Source URL copy and instant test throwing playground

screenshot.caption: Target setup and coordinate mapper in Yeet

description.p: Initial release of Yeet featuring Wayland-native Libadwaita UI, resolution-independent targets, REST API, and OBS overlay.
